title: Skull Piercer (Critical Hit)
description: Master the art of precision with 'Skull Piercer', a new primary enchantment supported by various complementary enchantments to maximize your bow's lethality.
body:
# Skull Piercer (Critical Hit)

**Redefine Archery in Minecraft. Master the Art of the Headshot.**

For too long, archery in Minecraft has simply been about pulling the string and hoping your arrow hits the target's general hitbox. **Skull Piercer** completely overhauls ranged combat by introducing a highly rewarding, skill-based headshot mechanic. This mod rewards precision, patience, and accuracy with devastating damage output and incredible visual feedback. 

Whether you are defending your base from a nighttime raid or delving into the darkest dimensions, Skull Piercer provides you with a brand-new arsenal of specialized enchantments designed to turn a simple bow into a lethal sniper rifle.

---

## The Core Mechanic: Precision Rewarded

### Deadshot (Levels I - IV)
**The Foundation of a True Marksman**
* **Acquisition:** Easily obtainable through the standard Enchanting Table.
* **Mechanic:** This is the essential enchantment that unlocks the true potential of this mod. Deadshot allows your arrows to recognize head hitboxes. Striking an enemy directly in the head triggers a massive critical damage multiplier, scaling significantly with each level of the enchantment.
* **Visual Feedback:** A true sniper deserves to see the impact of their perfect shot. Every successful headshot triggers a distinct skull particle effect. As you upgrade Deadshot from Level I to Level IV, these skull particles become increasingly intense and elaborate, giving you immediate, satisfying visual confirmation of your critical hits.
* **Technical Note on Precision:** Unlike other mods that calculate hits based on where a mob is looking, Skull Piercer utilizes a "True Hitbox" system. A headshot is registered only if your arrow physically intersects with the eye-level segment of the entity's hitbox (the red square visible when pressing F3+B). This ensures that your skill is the only factor—if you see the shot land on the head, it counts.
---

## The Arsenal: Legendary and Utility Enchantments

To truly master the battlefield, you will need to explore the world and conquer its most dangerous structures to find these exclusive, loot-only enchantments.

### King Crimson
**Unstoppable Momentum**
* **Acquisition:** Found exclusively within Nether Fortress chests (Rare).
* **Mechanic:** Combat in the Nether is fast and brutal, and King Crimson turns you into a relentless force. When you secure a kill via a headshot, this enchantment instantly grants you temporary Regeneration and Speed buffs. This allows you to quickly reposition, heal through incoming damage, and string together multiple headshot kills without ever losing your momentum. It is the perfect tool for taking on large hordes of enemies.

### Executioner
**The Ultimate Finisher**
* **Acquisition:** Located in Bastion Remnant Treasure Rooms (Uncommon - typically requires looting 2 to 3 Treasure Bastions to acquire).
* **Mechanic:** Some enemies simply refuse to go down quietly. Executioner is designed to end fights swiftly. When a target's health drops below the 20% threshold, your headshots will deal an unimaginably powerful critical strike. 
* **The Lethal Strike:** Furthermore, every headshot landed on an enemy below 20% health carries a flat 5% chance to trigger an Instant Kill. This incredibly potent effect applies to all entities in the game—including Bosses. 

### Golden Aim
**The Sniper's Sixth Sense**
* **Acquisition:** Highest drop rate in Buried Treasure chests; also rarely found in Shipwreck loot.
* **Mechanic:** True marksmen leave nothing to chance. Golden Aim provides a powerful tactical advantage by overlaying a targeting system onto your vision. The moment you draw your bow, this enchantment reveals glowing golden crosshairs locked directly onto the headshot hitboxes of all mobs currently visible on your screen. This allows for pinpoint accuracy in chaotic fights or pitch-black environments.

### Concussion (Levels I - II)
**Debilitating Precision**
* **Acquisition:** Found deep within Ancient Cities. The drop rate is rare, but thoroughly exploring the chests will yield results (unless you have exceptionally terrible luck).
* **Mechanic:** A headshot doesn't always have to be instantly lethal to end a fight. Concussion is designed for crowd control and debilitating powerful foes. Hitting a headshot inflicts severe status effects, turning the enemy into a sitting duck for your follow-up attacks.
  * **Level I:** A successful headshot inflicts Nausea and Slowness I, disorienting the target.
  * **Level II:** The impact is drastically increased, inflicting Nausea II and Slowness III. Enemies struck by Concussion II are practically immobilized, ensuring your next shot will not miss.

---

**Download Skull Piercer today, string your bow, and make every single shot count.**
